cost.q: How can AI reduce support costs?
cost.a: By deflecting repetitive tickets with a trained assistant, auto-drafting replies, and routing only complex cases to humans — typically cutting handling time significantly.

processes.a: Lead intake, data entry, approvals, reporting, follow-ups, and CRM updates are strong first candidates. We start with a short process-discovery workshop.

assistant.q: Can you build an internal company assistant?
assistant.a: Yes — a RAG assistant grounded in your policies, docs, and data, with role-based access, so staff get accurate answers in seconds.

qa.q: How can AI improve software testing?
qa.a: AI can generate test cases from requirements, maintain flaky selectors, triage failures, and expand coverage — alongside your existing automation.

ai-support-platform.challenge: A growing retailer was overwhelmed by repetitive support tickets and slow response times.
